items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Shorty had this band going to the Apollo

ctx.x: Yeah. I met him in St. Louis. Beautiful trumpet player. James Oliver Cobb, Baby Jane, I don't remember all.

Shorty Baker? No, Shorty's younger. Beautiful trumpet player. That's a funny thing that happened. It's around '28, too. There's a cab driver. So, ... I go to jam sessions. I made out all right. Of course, I had some ideas of what to do.
